name: Mack Landing (Apalachicola National Forest)
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Small Forest Service campground with picnic tables, non-flush toilets and a concrete boat ramp; a camp host is present October through March. Pay by Recreation.gov Scan & Pay at the kiosk, so install the app before arriving because cell signal may be spotty.
access: First come, first served. Stay limit: 14 days, suspended during general gun season Derived, not read from the 2026-27 brochure (FWC brochure app errored): rule text says general gun is 'the first 58 days of Zone D antlered deer season'; with FWC's 2026-27 Zone D dates that is Nov 26-29, 2026 and Dec 12, 2026 - Feb 3, 2027. Rule: on National Forest lands camping is 'only on designated campsites during general gun season', so on Nov 26-29 roadside dispersed camping in Apalachicola NF is not legal and a listed hunt camp or campground is the legal choice. Small game season opens the second Saturday of November outside general gun days. Orange requirement not checked; expect armed hunters in camp over Thanksgiving weekend. Mack Landing doubles as a hunt camp; non-hunters may camp but are told to 'Be aware of hunting environment'.

conditions.summary: Forest Service page shows 'Site Open', 'Open year round'. Drinking water is listed in amenities but the same page says potable water is not available. (source dated 2026-10-05)
